title: Pack Traceability (two plants, 40 warehouses)
summary: Packaging lines request GS1 serial ranges and upload commissioned serials and aggregation through the L3 interface; cases and pallets are sealed, shipped and received between plants, warehouses and distributors as EPCIS 2.0 events with exception handling; distributors verify packs on receipt; QA quarantines or recalls a batch and tracks every location's returns to closure. Batch and recall 360 pages.
